Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your

Yours faithfully,
A/Director of Criminal Investigation.

pages.en:
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
File No. D. 651
13. 11. 29

The report embodied in attached
communication gives absolutely no
information which could be made a
starting point for investigation;
In fact that habit of giving the prescribed
classes of members of the C.P. is absurd
& the same form should be applied to
indentification by the appearance of the
character slung under the arm.

I cannot understand the mentality of
the person or persons responsible for the
circulation of this report. I would suggest
that the matter finish with the usual
acknowledgment to the Provincial Court.
Thos Robertson
C. D.

Yes
But treat it
as circumstances
arise
Rea
pages.zh:
（刑事调查处）办公笔记
档案编号 D. 651
1929年11月13日

附函中所载的报告完全没有提供可作为调查起点的任何信息；
事实上，那种按规定描述共产党员类别的做法是荒谬的，同样的形式竟被用于通过夹在腋下的字符外观来进行识别。

我无法理解负责传播这份报告的人或那些人的心态。我建议此事以向省法院发出常规收讫回复作结。
托马斯·罗伯逊
刑事调查处处长

同意
但视情况
处理
里亚

PUBLIC REGISTER
D. 651
14.11.29

Translation.

Shanghai Provisional Court,
Shanghai, November 8, 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,

Sir,

I have received Secret Instruction No. 5737 from the Kiang-
su Provincial Government quoting Secret Instruction received
from the National Government quoting petition submitted by Gen-
eral Chang Kai-Shek quoting telegram received from Lieu Sze
Yuen, Organising and Discharging Commissioner of Hupeh, quoting
telegram received from Au Tau Ying, Chief-in-command of the
28th Division of the Army acting concurrently as Head of the
First Pacification Division stating as follows:-

"A report has been submitted by Lieutenant
Tan Ho Seang stating that two Communists
had been arrested at the South Gate City
of Wang An. After undergoing strict trials
they have confessed that the dress of the
Communists are all in white short shirts
and trousers with straw hats. The Badge sign
of the Chief is colored in red and that of
the member in white. Their secret sign is
a letter "Goong" written under the left arm
with a chemically made pen. Apart from issu-
ing general orders to the Heads of the various
Pacification Divisions for strict and secret
investigations to be made, you are requested
to have this matter considered."

“谭浩祥（音译）中尉提交报告称，两名共产党人在王安城南门被捕。经严加审讯，他们供认共产党人的着装均为白色短衫裤配草帽。首领的徽章标志为红色，成员的为白色。他们的秘密记号是用化学药水笔在左臂下写一个‘共’字。除向各绥靖区主任发布一般命令进行严格且秘密的调查外，请贵方对此事予以考虑。”
